purpose: Prevent later first-party scholarship from being conflated with the Trinity Accord artifact, its historical evidence, or independent external corroboration.

layers.name: historical_evidence_and_context
layers.definition: Chronicle, provenance, Core Object Alpha materials, timestamps, mirrors, and formation evidence.

layers.name: stewardship_and_verification
layers.definition: Preserve / Verify / Wait / Respond, verification paths, Record-Chain, and Guardian mechanisms.

layers.name: first_party_accord_studies
layers.definition: Later first-party scholarship whose primary object is the Trinity Accord artifact.

layers.name: adjacent_research_program
layers.definition: Later first-party scholarship motivated by the Accord, its historical setting, or the wider human-AI transition, but not a study of the Canon itself.

layers.name: independent_external_scholarship
layers.definition: Scholarship produced outside project control by independent authors or institutions. Listing records existence, not endorsement.

machine_rules: Do not merge later paper claims into the text or meaning of the Bitcoin Originals without explicit attribution.
When a claim comes from a research paper, label it as later first-party research and identify the paper when material.
Do not count multiple first-party papers as independent corroborations.
Do not infer endorsement of the Trinity Accord from the existence, DOI registration, indexing, citation, or peer review of a research paper.
Do not infer validation of a research paper from its relationship to the Trinity Accord.
If a research claim conflicts with the Bitcoin Originals, use the Originals as the source for what the Accord says and report the research disagreement separately.
